recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Roll out pizza dough.
Spread tomato sauce over the dough.
Top with mozzarella and basil.
Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente.
Fry bacon until crispy.
Whisk eggs and mix with Parmesan cheese.
Toss pasta with bacon and egg mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine until al dente.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, then cook in a pan until golden.
Melt butter, add garlic, and cook until fragrant.
Add heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth.
Toss the fettuccine and chicken in the Alfredo sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan with olive oil.
Add taco seasoning and cook according to package instructions.
Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and sour cream.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Top with croutons and grated Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle black pepper on top and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix flour, cocoa powder, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract in another bowl.
Combine both mixtures and pour into a greased cake tin.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, then let cool before frosting.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Chop vegetables and sauté with garlic in a pot.
Add tomato paste and vegetable broth.
Simmer for 30 minutes, adding herbs, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Bread the chicken by dipping in egg and then breadcrumbs.
Fry the chicken until golden brown on both sides.
Top with marinara sauce and mozzarella, then bake in the oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Lemonade
instructions: Mix lemon juice, sugar, and water in a pitcher.
Stir until sugar dissolves, then add ice.
Serve chilled with lemon slices.
